extracted.intended_audience: journalists, reporters, editors, copy editors, and newsroom staff
extracted.subtask_short: AP style and media law guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive style and legal guidance for news writing and newsroom procedures, covering usage, punctuation, section-specific style (internet, sports, business), metadata/filing practices, and a briefing on media law (libel, privacy, First Amendment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylebook Key / A-to-Z guides
rubrics_metrics.description: An A to Z listing of guides to capitalization, abbreviation, spelling, numerals and usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on capitalization (part of the A-to-Z listing of usage rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on abbreviations (part of the A-to-Z listing of usage rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preferred spellings (part of the A-to-Z listing of usage rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Numerals
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for writing numbers (part of the A-to-Z listing of usage rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Usage
rubrics_metrics.description: General usage guidance (part of the A-to-Z listing of rules for writers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Style and usage rules specific to internet reporting and online content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports guidelines and style
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized style guidance for sports reporting and sports-related copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business guidelines and style
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized style guidance for business reporting and business-related copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: A Guide to Punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance on punctuation usage for clear and consistent news writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Briefing on Media Law (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: A comprehensive briefing on media law covering libel, privacy, First Amendment, and related legal issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains multiple subtopics including 'What Is Libel?', 'Liability for Republication', 'Privileges', 'Defenses', 'Supreme Court Decisions Regarding Libel Law', 'Summary of First Amendment Rules', 'Public and Private Plaintiffs', 'Miscellaneous', 'Applying the Rules', and 'Points to Remember'.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Is Libel?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of libel as a legal concept relevant to journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability for Republication
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance on when republication creates legal liability for a news organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privileges
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal privileges applicable to reporting (e.g., certain protections for journalists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Defenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Possible legal defenses in media law cases (e.g., truth, opinion, privilege).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supreme Court Decisions Regarding Libel Law
rubrics_metrics.description: Summaries or references to key Supreme Court decisions that affect libel law for the press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of First Amendment Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of First Amendment principles relevant to journalists and publishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public and Private Plaintiffs
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinctions and rules that apply when plaintiffs are public figures versus private individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying the Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical guidance on applying media law rules in newsroom situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Points to Remember
rubrics_metrics.description: Key takeaways and reminders for reporters concerning legal and ethical obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for Handling Kills and Correctives
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsroom procedures for killing stories and issuing corrections or corrective actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Places of Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on lawful access to information sources and places (e.g., public meetings, records).

rubrics_metrics.name: The Right of Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal and ethical guidance on privacy rights and restrictions in reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules regarding copyright as it pertains to journalistic content and use of materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo Captions
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for writing photo captions, including copyright and attribution considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caption Corrections, Additions, Eliminations
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correcting, adding, or removing photo captions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo Kills and Eliminations
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for removing or killing photos from use (legal or editorial reasons).

rubrics_metrics.name: NAA/IPTC Header Fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Metadata/header field standards (NAA/IPTC) for image and story transmission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional categorization fields used in filing or distributing content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing the Wire
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and practices for filing copy to the wire service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coding Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical or coding requirements for electronic transmission and formatting of stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keyword Slug Line
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of keyword slug lines for categorization and retrieval of stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Version Section

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference Number Section

rubrics_metrics.name: Format Identifiers

rubrics_metrics.description: AP-specific notes or rules that apply to member organizations and contributors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Practices
rubrics_metrics.description: General filing practices for newsroom workflows and syndication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proofreaders' Marks
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard proofreaders' marks and correction conventions used in copyediting.

rubrics_metrics.name: About the AP
